senses.gloss: (sec. r. of אוּץ, v. אָנִיץ) to squeeze in, fasten.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 12:11">Targ. Koh. XII, 11</cite> <he>דאנצין</he>, read <he>דאֲנִיצִין</he> which are fastened (h. text <he>נטועים</he>; gloss <he>דאציתין</he>, clerical error for <he>דאניצין</he> or <he>דנציבין</he>, embodied in the text of some ed.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 13:21">Targ. I Sam. XIII, 21</cite>, Ar., v. <cite ref="N01098"><he>נְצַב</he></cite>.
